newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Heng Fung raises HK$32 mln in placmement.
newsitem.headline: Heng Fung raises HK$32 mln in placmement.

text.p: Hong Kong's Heng Fung Holdings Co Ltd said on Monday it had agreed to place 77.6 million new shares to 10 private and individual investors, independent of the company at HK$0.42 per share, raising HK$31.9 million.

The new shares would represent about 19.8 percent of the company's existing issued share capital, the company said in a statement. It said it was in the commercial interests of the company to raise additional funds for working capital.
Heng Fung shares closed at HK$0.57 on Friday.

The company said Executive Director Ng Mok Yuen and Chairman Chan Heng Fai and his wife Chan Yoke Keow would own about 20.17 percent and 15.56 percent respectively of the enlarged issued share capital of the company after the placement against 24.17 percent and 18.64 percent of the existing capital.
